entries.title: cell-coordinate bijection
entries.body: Each represented cell has exactly one column/row pair, and each represented column/row pair has exactly one represented cell.
entries.witness: Exhaust the frozen 42 CELL_COORD tuples; no duplicate cell or coordinate pair occurs.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: column reflection is an involutive bijection
entries.body: REFLECT_COLUMN is single-valued, total on columns, bijective, and applying it twice returns the original column.
entries.witness: The exact seven-pair extension consists of three swaps plus the fixed center.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: cell reflection is an involutive bijection
entries.body: REFLECT_CELL is single-valued and total on cells, and reflecting twice returns the original cell.
entries.witness: Transport unique CELL_COORD through involutive REFLECT_COLUMN at fixed row.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: above-cell relation is reflection-equivariant
entries.body: If ABOVE(x,y), REFLECT_CELL(x,rx), and REFLECT_CELL(y,ry), then ABOVE(rx,ry).
entries.witness: ABOVE preserves row increment and column equality; reflection changes only column.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: singleton residual term is unique per cell
entries.body: For every represented cell x there is exactly one represented term t with SINGLETON(t,x).
entries.witness: Every cell occurs in at least one frozen winning line; singleton subsets are deduplicated extensionally.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: term equality is an equivalence relation
entries.body: TERM_EQ is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive on represented terms.
entries.witness: Extensional biconditional equality over TERM_HAS has the three equality laws.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: term subset is reflexive and transitive
entries.body: TERM_SUBSET(t,t), and TERM_SUBSET(t,u) with TERM_SUBSET(u,v) implies TERM_SUBSET(t,v).
entries.witness: Pointwise implication over TERM_HAS composes.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: strict term subset is a strict partial order
entries.body: TERM_STRICT_SUBSET is irreflexive, asymmetric, and transitive.
entries.witness: Strict subset is subset plus extensional non-equality.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: term removal is unique when a represented result exists
entries.body: If TERM_REMOVE(t,x,u) and TERM_REMOVE(t,x,v), then TERM_EQ(u,v).
entries.witness: Both results have the same pointwise membership formula.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: degree-two term endpoints are symmetric
entries.body: DEGREE2(t,x,y) iff DEGREE2(t,y,x).
entries.witness: The definition is invariant under swapping its two distinct endpoint variables.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: pair incidence is symmetric
entries.body: PAIR_INCIDENCE(x,t,y) iff PAIR_INCIDENCE(y,t,x).
entries.witness: PAIR_INCIDENCE is exactly DEGREE2 in either endpoint orientation.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: cell masks are one-hot and injective
entries.body: Each represented cell mask contains exactly one set bit across its two 32-bit halves, and distinct cells have distinct mask pairs.
entries.witness: The frozen CELL_MASK extension maps cells 0..41 to unique one-hot low/high words.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support height is functional
entries.body: For SUPPORT_VALID(S) and any represented column c, exactly one represented height h satisfies SUPPORT_AT(S,c,h).
entries.witness: SUPPORT_VALID supplies one field per column and field functionality collapses duplicates.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: landing cell is functional on a playable column
entries.body: For SUPPORT_VALID(S) and a column whose height is a represented row 0..5, exactly one cell x satisfies LANDING(S,c,x).
entries.witness: Unique support height plus CELL_COORD bijection gives a unique landing cell.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: playable frontier has at most one cell per column
entries.body: For a valid support, each non-full column contributes exactly one PLAYABLE cell and a height-6 column contributes none.
entries.witness: PLAYABLE is existential LANDING and LANDING is unique exactly for row heights.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support step is functional up to support equality
entries.body: If SUPPORT_STEP(S,c,T) and SUPPORT_STEP(S,c,U), then SUPPORT_EQ(T,U).
entries.witness: Both targets increment the same unique field and preserve every other field.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support equality is an equivalence relation
entries.body: SUPPORT_EQ is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.
entries.witness: Extensional equality of the seven height fields.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support rank is functional
entries.body: If RANK(S,n) and RANK(S,m), then n=m.
entries.witness: The seven unique heights feed functional primitive addition composition.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: valid-support rank lies in 0..42
entries.body: Every SUPPORT_VALID support has a unique rank n with 0 <= n <= 42.
entries.witness: Seven heights each lie in 0..6; their represented natural sum is bounded by 42.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: side to move is total and exclusive
entries.body: For every valid support exactly one of SIDE(S,P0) or SIDE(S,P1) holds.
entries.witness: Every natural rank 0..42 has exactly one parity.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support step increments rank
entries.body: SUPPORT_STEP(S,c,T), RANK(S,n), and RANK(T,m) imply m=succ(n).
entries.witness: Exactly one height increases by one and all others are fixed.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support step alternates side to move
entries.body: SUPPORT_STEP(S,c,T) implies SIDE(S,P0) iff SIDE(T,P1), and SIDE(S,P1) iff SIDE(T,P0).
entries.witness: Successor rank flips parity.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: residual equality is an equivalence relation
entries.body: RESIDUAL_EQ is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive on valid residuals.
entries.witness: Extensional biconditional equality over term membership.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: block transition is functional up to residual equality
entries.body: If BLOCK_TRANSITION(A,x,B) and BLOCK_TRANSITION(A,x,C), then RESIDUAL_EQ(B,C).
entries.witness: Both outputs contain exactly the A terms not containing x.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: own transition is functional up to residual equality
entries.body: If OWN_TRANSITION(A,x,B) and OWN_TRANSITION(A,x,C), then RESIDUAL_EQ(B,C).
entries.witness: Both outputs are exactly the strict-subset-minimal OWN_CANDIDATE terms.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: own win excludes own transition
entries.body: OWN_WIN(A,x) implies there is no B with OWN_TRANSITION(A,x,B).
entries.witness: OWN_TRANSITION explicitly requires NOT OWN_WIN.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: block transition preserves residual validity
entries.body: BLOCK_TRANSITION(A,x,B) implies RESIDUAL_VALID(B).
entries.witness: Target validity is a conjunct of the exact transition definition.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: own transition preserves residual validity
entries.body: OWN_TRANSITION(A,x,B) implies RESIDUAL_VALID(B).
entries.witness: Target validity is a conjunct of the exact transition definition.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: own-transition output is candidate-minimal
entries.body: OWN_TRANSITION(A,x,B) and B(u) imply OWN_CANDIDATE(A,x,u) and no strict-subset OWN_CANDIDATE(A,x,v) exists.
entries.witness: Direct biconditional elimination from the target-membership definition.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q_o equality is an equivalence relation
entries.body: QO_EQ is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive on Q_VALID objects.
entries.witness: QO_EQ is product extensional equality of support and two residuals.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q side is total and exclusive
entries.body: For Q_VALID(q), exactly one of QSIDE(q,P0) or QSIDE(q,P1) holds.
entries.witness: QSIDE projects the unique support SIDE.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: legal landing is unique
entries.body: For Q_VALID(q) and LEGAL(q,c), the q support has exactly one landing cell x for c.
entries.witness: LEGAL is defined by existence of LANDING; LANDING is functional.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: immediate outcome and q successor are mutually exclusive
entries.body: For the same Q_VALID q and legal c, IMMEDIATE(q,c,v) excludes every Q_STEP(q,c,qp).
entries.witness: IMMEDIATE requires mover OWN_WIN; Q_STEP requires its negation before OWN_TRANSITION.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q successor is functional up to q_o equality
entries.body: If Q_STEP(q,c,u) and Q_STEP(q,c,v), then QO_EQ(u,v).
entries.witness: Side selects one mover; support and both residual outputs are each functional up to extensional equality.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: no-legal state is exactly all columns full
entries.body: For Q_VALID(q), NO_LEGAL(q) iff each support column has height 6.
entries.witness: A column is LEGAL exactly when its support height is a row 0..5.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: value range is exactly WDL
entries.body: VALUE(q,v) implies v is one of {-1,0,+1}.
entries.witness: The value variable is quantified over the finite WDL carrier.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: support reflection is involutive up to support equality
entries.body: REFLECT_SUPPORT(S,T) and REFLECT_SUPPORT(T,U) imply SUPPORT_EQ(S,U).
entries.witness: Each support field is transported by an involutive column map.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: term reflection is involutive up to term equality
entries.body: REFLECT_TERM(t,u) and REFLECT_TERM(u,v) imply TERM_EQ(t,v).
entries.witness: TERM_HAS membership is transported by an involutive cell map.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: residual reflection is involutive up to residual equality
entries.body: REFLECT_RESIDUAL(A,B) and REFLECT_RESIDUAL(B,C) imply RESIDUAL_EQ(A,C).
entries.witness: Residual membership is transported by involutive term reflection.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q reflection is involutive up to q_o equality
entries.body: REFLECT_Q(q,r) and REFLECT_Q(r,s) imply QO_EQ(q,s).
entries.witness: All three q fields return extensionally after two reflections.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q_r is reflexive
entries.body: Q_VALID(q) implies QR_EQ(q,q).
entries.witness: The first disjunct of QR_EQ is QO_EQ.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: own win and singleton projection coincide
entries.body: For a valid residual A, OWN_WIN(A,x) iff SINGLE_AT(A,x).
entries.witness: Both relations quantify the same singleton residual witness.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: effect class is functional
entries.body: For legal (q,c), EFFECT(q,c,e1) and EFFECT(q,c,e2) imply e1=e2.
entries.witness: The veto/zero/one/two-or-more cases are mutually exclusive and each selects one raw effect token.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: effect class is total on legal actions
entries.body: For Q_VALID(q) and LEGAL(q,c), exactly one effect class 0,1,2 is related by EFFECT.
entries.witness: The represented cases exhaust veto versus non-veto and zero/one/two-or-more completion witnesses.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: promoted column is unique when it exists
entries.body: PROMOTE(q,c) and PROMOTE(q,d) imply c=d.
entries.witness: Finite BEFORE is a strict total order and PROMOTE forbids an earlier tied/maximal competitor.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: task-control result is functional
entries.body: A valid task-control state has at most one represented task-control result.
entries.witness: Abort, retirement, split, and continue guards are pairwise exclusive by precedence.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: task-control result is total
entries.body: A valid task-control state has exactly one of ABORTED, RETIRED, SPLIT, CONTINUE.
entries.witness: The four precedence cases exhaust Boolean abort/needed and the budget comparison.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: next control threshold is functional
entries.body: For a CONTINUE task-control state, NEXT_CONTROL has exactly one natural result.
entries.witness: Primitive addition and order select the unique minimum of budget and nodes+512.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q dependency graph is acyclic
entries.body: There is no nonempty directed Q_DEPENDENCY cycle.
entries.witness: Every edge strictly increments bounded natural rank.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base

entries.title: q dependency path length is bounded
entries.body: Every Q_DEPENDENCY path from rank n contains at most 42-n edges.
entries.witness: Each edge consumes one remaining rank and rank cannot exceed 42.
entries.provenance: derived from frozen A0 assertion base
